      home: https://gcc.gnu.org/
      license: GPL-3.0-only WITH GCC-exception-3.1

    requirements:
      host:
        - {{ pin_subpackage("gfortran_impl_" ~ cross_target_platform, exact=True) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage("gcc_impl_" ~ cross_target_platform, exact=True) }}
        - binutils_impl_{{ cross_target_platform }} {{ binutils_version }}.* bootstrap_*   # [cross_target_platform not in ("osx-arm64", "osx-64")]
        - {{ pin_subpackage("gcc", exact=True) }}
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage("gfortran_impl_" ~ cross_target_platform, exact=True) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage("gcc_impl_" ~ cross_target_platform, exact=True) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage("gcc", exact=True) }}
        - conda-gcc-specs        # [with_conda_specs]
    test:
      commands:
        - ${PREFIX}/bin/gfortran -v
        - ${PREFIX}/bin/gcc -v
    about:
      summary: GNU Fortran native compiler (symlinks)
      home: https://github.com/conda-forge/ctng-compilers-feedstock
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_file: LICENSE

  - name: libstdcxx
    target: {{ cross_target_platform }}
    script: install-libstdc++.sh
    build:
      number: {{ build_num }}
      skip: true                # [target_platform != cross_target_platform or cross_target_cxx_stdlib != "libstdcxx"]
      detect_binary_files_with_prefix: false
      missing_dso_whitelist:
        - "*"
    requirements:
      build:
      host:
        - {{ cross_target_stdlib }}_{{ cross_target_platform }} {{ cross_target_stdlib_version }}  # [cross_target_stdlib != "None"]
        - {{ pin_subpackage("libgcc", exact=True) }}
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage("libgcc", exact=True) }}
      run_constrained:
        # avoid installing incompatible version of old name for this output
        - libstdcxx-ng =={{ version }}=*_{{ build_num }}
    test:
      commands:
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libstdc++.so
    about:
      summary: The GNU C++ Runtime Library
      home: https://gcc.gnu.org/
      license: GPL-3.0-only WITH GCC-exception-3.1

  - name: libsanitizer
    target: {{ cross_target_platform }}
    script: install-libsanitizer.sh
    build:
      number: {{ build_num }}
      skip: true                # [target_platform != cross_target_platform or win or osx]
      detect_binary_files_with_prefix: false
      missing_dso_whitelist:
        - "*"
      run_exports:
        - libsanitizer {{ gcc_version }}
    requirements:
      build:
      host:
        - {{ cross_target_stdlib }}_{{ cross_target_platform }}  {{ cross_target_stdlib_version }}  # [cross_target_stdlib != "None"]
      run:
        - libgcc >={{ gcc_version }}
        - libstdcxx >={{ gcc_version }}
    test:
      requires:
        - {{ cross_target_stdlib }}_{{ cross_target_platform }}  # [cross_target_stdlib != "None"]
        - gcc_impl_{{ cross_target_platform }}
        - binutils_impl_{{ cross_target_platform }} {{ binutils_version }}.* bootstrap_*   # [cross_target_platform not in ("osx-arm64", "osx-64")]
      commands:
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libasan.so
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libhwasan.so   # [x86_64 or aarch64]
        - file ${PREFIX}/bin/{{ TARGET }}-gcc
        - echo 'void main(){}' | {{ TARGET }}-gcc -fsanitize=address -Wl,--fatal-warnings -x c -
    about:
      summary: The GCC runtime libraries for sanitizers
      home: https://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/gccint/Libgcc.html
      license: GPL-3.0-only WITH GCC-exception-3.1

  - name: libgomp
    target: {{ cross_target_platform }}
    script: install-libgomp.sh
    build:
      number: {{ build_num }}
      skip: true                # [target_platform != cross_target_platform or osx]
      detect_binary_files_with_prefix: false
      missing_dso_whitelist:
        - "*"
      run_exports:
        strong:
          - {{ pin_subpackage("_openmp_mutex", max_pin=None) }}
          {% if cross_target_platform.startswith("win-") %}
          - {{ pin_subpackage("libgomp", max_pin=None) }}
          {% endif %}
    requirements:
      build:
      host:
        - {{ cross_target_stdlib }}_{{ cross_target_platform }}  {{ cross_target_stdlib_version }}  # [cross_target_stdlib != "None"]
      run_constrained:
        - msys2-conda-epoch <0.0a0    # [win]
    test:
      requires:
        - {{ cross_target_stdlib }}_{{ cross_target_platform }}  # [cross_target_stdlib != "None"]
      commands:
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libgomp.so.{{ libgomp_ver }}
        - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libgomp.so.{{ libgomp_ver[0:1] }}
    about:
      summary: The GCC OpenMP implementation.
      home: https://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/gccint/Libgcc.html
      license: GPL-3.0-only WITH GCC-exception-3.1

  - name: libgcc
    target: {{ cross_target_platform }}
    script: install-libgcc-no-gomp.sh
    build:

      skip: true                # [target_platform != cross_target_platform]
      detect_binary_files_with_prefix: false
      missing_dso_whitelist:
        - "*"
      rpaths_patcher: patchelf
    requirements:
      build:
      host:

        - {{ pin_subpackage('_openmp_mutex', exact=True) }}                                         # [not osx]
        - {{ cross_target_stdlib }}_{{ cross_target_platform }}  {{ cross_target_stdlib_version }}  # [cross_target_stdlib != "None"]
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage("_openmp_mutex", max_pin=None) }}                                       # [not osx]
        - _openmp_mutex                                                                             # [osx]
      run_constrained:
        - {{ pin_subpackage("libgomp", exact=True) }}
        - msys2-conda-epoch <0.0a0    # [win]
        # avoid installing incompatible version of old name for this output
        - libgcc-ng =={{ version }}=*_{{ build_num }}

      requires:
        - {{ cross_target_stdlib }}_{{ cross_target_platform }}  # [cross_target_stdlib != "None"]
      commands:
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libgcc_s.so                                                         # [linux]

        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libgomp.so.{{ libgomp_ver[0:1] }}                                   # [linux]
        - test `readlink ${PREFIX}/lib/libgomp.so.{{ libgomp_ver[0:1] }}` == "libgomp.so.{{ libgomp_ver }}"   # [linux]
        - test `readlink ${PREFIX}/lib/libgomp.so.{{ libgomp_ver[0:1] }}` == "libgomp.so.{{ libgomp_ver }}"   # [linux]
    about:
      summary: The GCC low-level runtime library
      home: https://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/gccint/Libgcc.html
      license: GPL-3.0-only WITH GCC-exception-3.1

      license_file: LICENSE
      home: https://github.com/conda-forge/ctng-compilers-feedstock

      run_constrained:
        - conda-gcc-specs <0.0a0
    test:
      commands:
        - gcc --version

  - name: conda-gcc-specs
    script: install-conda-specs.sh
    build:
      number: {{ build_num }}
      skip: true                # [cross_target_platform != target_platform]
      detect_binary_files_with_prefix: false
    requirements:
      build:
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage("gcc_impl_" ~ cross_target_platform, max_pin='x.x.x.x') }}
    test:
      files:
        - tests
      commands:
        - specdir=$PREFIX/lib/gcc/{{ TARGET }}/{{ gcc_version }}
        - test -f $specdir/conda.specs
        - CC=$(${PREFIX}/bin/*-gcc -dumpmachine)-gcc
        - echo | ${CC} -E -v -x c - |& grep '^Reading specs from' | awk '{print $NF}' | xargs readlink -e | awk -v ORS= '{print $1":"}' | grep "${specdir}/specs:${specdir}/conda.specs:"  # [linux]
        - cp tests/libhowdy.h $PREFIX/include/
        - ${CC} -shared -fpic -o $PREFIX/lib/libhowdy.so tests/libhowdy.c
        - ${CC} -o howdy-dso tests/howdy-dso.c -lhowdy
        - ./howdy-dso
        -    grep RPATH   <({{ TARGET }}-readelf -d howdy-dso)    # [linux]
        - "! grep RUNPATH <({{ TARGET }}-readelf -d howdy-dso)"   # [linux]
        - ${CC} -Wl,-enable-new-dtags -o howdy-dso-runpath tests/howdy-dso.c -lhowdy  # [linux]
        - ./howdy-dso-runpath                                                         # [linux]
        - "! grep RPATH   <({{ TARGET }}-readelf -d howdy-dso-runpath)"              # [linux]
        -    grep RUNPATH <({{ TARGET }}-readelf -d howdy-dso-runpath)               # [linux]
        # $PREFIX/include is searched before the sysroot's include directories
        - echo | ${CC} -E -Wp,-v -x c - |& awk '/include <\.\.\.> search starts/,/^End of search/ {print}' | head -n2 | tail -n1 | grep "$PREFIX/include"  # [linux]
        # user passed -isystem is searched before $PREFIX/include
        - mkdir -p userinc && echo | ${CC} -isystem $PWD/userinc -E -Wp,-v -x c - |& awk '/include <\.\.\.> search starts/,/^End of search/ {print}' | head -n2 | tail -n1 | grep "userinc"  # [linux]
        - echo | ${CC} -isystem "$PREFIX/include" -E -Wp,-v -x c - |& awk '/include <\.\.\.> search starts/, /^End of search/ {print}' | head -n2 | tail -n1 | grep "$PREFIX/include"  # [linux]

    about:
      summary: conda-specific specfile for GNU C/C++ Compiler
      description: |
          When installed, this optional package provides a specfile that
          directs gcc (and g++ or gfortran) to automatically:
            * search for includes in $PREFIX/include
            * link libraries in $PREFIX/lib
            * set RPATH to $PREFIX/lib
            * use RPATH instead of the newer RUNPATH
          This package is intended to aid usability of the compiler
          toolchain as a replacement for system-installed compilers.
          It should not be used in recipes.  Use the 'compiler(<lang>)'
          jinja function as described on
          https://conda-forge.org/docs/maintainer/knowledge_base.html#dep-compilers
      home: https://gcc.gnu.org/
      license: GPL-3.0-only WITH GCC-exception-3.1
      doc_url: https://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/gcc/Spec-Files.html

        - ${CXX} -isystem ${PREFIX}/include --std=c++20 -Wall tests/tzdb.cpp -c -o tzdb.o -v
        {% if target_platform == cross_target_platform %}
        - ${CXX} tzdb-override.o -o tzdb-override -v && ./tzdb-override
        - ${CXX} tzdb.o -o tzdb -v && ./tzdb
        - strace ./tzdb 2>&1 | grep ${CONDA_PREFIX}/lib/../share/zoneinfo/tzdata.zi
        # also test without any environment activation
        - unset PREFIX
        - unset CONDA_PREFIX
        - ./tzdb
        {% endif %}
      {% endif %}
    about:
      summary: GNU C++ Compiler
      home: https://gcc.gnu.org/
      license: GPL-3.0-only WITH GCC-exception-3.1

package:
  name: sqlite-split
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://www.sqlite.org/{{ year }}/sqlite-autoconf-{{ version_coded }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 0e9483900e92cd5de8fd48d16bf9200145a61f7fd5be542a5ac81d8a9516eb9c

build:
  number: {{ build_number }}

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ compiler('c') }}
    - {{ stdlib("c") }}
    - make  # [not win]
  host:
    - icu  # [with_icu]
    - ncurses  # [not win]
    - readline  # [not win]
    - zlib  # [not win]


outputs:
  - name: libsqlite
    build:
      run_exports:
        # sometimes adds new symbols.  Default behavior is OK.
        #    https://abi-laboratory.pro/tracker/timeline/sqlite/
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libsqlite') }}
    files:
      - lib/libsqlite*             # [unix]
      - include/sqlite*.h          # [unix]
      - lib/pkgconfig/sqlite3.pc   # [unix]
      - Library\bin\sqlite3.dll    # [win]
      - Library\lib\sqlite3.lib    # [win]
      - Library\include\sqlite*.h  # [win]
      - Library\lib\pkgconfig\sqlite3.pc  # [win]
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ compiler('c') }}
        - {{ stdlib("c") }}
        - make  # [not win]
      host:
        # readline and ncurses are only required by the executable
        # not the library. Leaving it out of the host requirements
        # ensures it doesn't appear in the run section (through run_export)
        - icu  # [with_icu]
        - zlib  # [not win]
      run_constrained:
        - icu <0.0a0  # [not with_icu and not win]
    test:
      commands:
        - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libsqlite3${SHLIB_EXT}  # [not win]
        - test ! -f $PREFIX/lib/libsqlite3.a  # [not win]
        - test -f $PREFIX/include/sqlite3.h  # [not win]
        - test -f $PREFIX/include/sqlite3ext.h  # [not win]
        - test -f $PREFIX/lib/pkgconfig/sqlite3.pc  # [not win]
        - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\bin\sqlite3.dll exit 1  # [win]
        - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\lib\sqlite3.lib exit 1  # [win]
        - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\include\sqlite3.h exit 1  # [win]
        - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\include\sqlite3ext.h exit 1  # [win]
        - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\lib\pkgconfig\sqlite3.pc exit 1  # [win]
  - name: sqlite
    build:
      run_exports:
        # sometimes adds new symbols.  Default behavior is OK.
        #    https://abi-laboratory.pro/tracker/timeline/sqlite/
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libsqlite') }}
    files:
      - bin/sqlite3              # [unix]
      - Library\bin\sqlite3.exe  # [win]
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ compiler('c') }}
        - {{ stdlib("c") }}
        - make  # [not win]
      host:
        - icu  # [with_icu]
        - ncurses  # [not win]
        - readline  # [not win]
        - zlib  # [not win]
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libsqlite', exact=True) }}
      # sqlite depends on libsqlite exactly, so the constraint applies
      # to the CLI package too
      # run_constrained:
      #  - icu <0.0a0  # [not with_icu and not win]
    test:
      commands:
        - sqlite3 --version
        - echo "PRAGMA compile_options;" | sqlite3  # [not win]
        - echo PRAGMA compile_options; | sqlite3    # [win]
